kalshiFee.maker_fee_applies_to: only series whose fee_type is quadratic_with_maker_fees; 0 on plain quadratic series
kalshiFee.rounding: Round up. Fee schedule: total trade fee rounded up to the next cent. Current API mechanics: model fee rounded up to $0.000001, then a rounding fee aligns the balance to $0.01 (non-direct / FCM-cleared members) or $0.0001 (direct members); rounding over-collection is carried per order and rebated across fills.
